title: 10 Good Habits for Kids 🌟
description: Learn 10 good habits for kids through fun and colorful animation! 🪥 Brush your teeth, 🧼 wash your hands, 🛁 take a bath, 🍎 eat healthy food, 💧 drink water, 🌙 sleep on time, 🧸 put your toys away, 🗑️ use the trash bin, 🙏 say please and thank you, and 🤝 help others. A fun and simple educational video for toddlers, preschoolers, and early learners.
